# Adaptive chamfer contact fixtures

Inputs 001 and 003 are byte-identical native C1 equal-distance sequence inputs
from audits/fillet-chamfer/capture/2026-10-20-tilted-cap-unequal/artifacts.zip.
They contain curved B-spline caps and extruded walls. Tests verify contact fitting,
not complete chamfer solids: downstream face trimming remains unsupported.
See truck-benchmarks/results/2026-10-20-adaptive-chamfer-contacts for parent
failures, source hashes, raw reference evidence and validation.
